risk_rationale: The proposed infrastructure change modifies public network reachability.

findings.title: Management port exposed to the internet
findings.source_to_sink: 0.0.0.0/0 reaches TCP 22 on the attached administrative security group
preconditions: The security group is attached to a reachable resource

evidence.summary: The ingress source changed from an internal range to all IPv4 addresses.

findings.impact: An administrative service can become reachable from untrusted networks.
findings.exploitability: Requires an attached resource, effective route, and listening SSH service.
findings.false_positive_considerations: Deployment attachment and route state must be confirmed.
findings.recommendation: Restrict access to the approved administrative source or broker.
verification: Inspect the rendered infrastructure plan and effective security-group attachment.

required_actions: Restore the approved administrative source restriction.
